items.title: 5.5 Elastic bigaar, plastic bigaar aur elastic limit (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.5 with Fig. 5.5 and Example 5.1 (PDF 98-99).

blocks.text: Tensile test mein dhaat ki wire muqarrar bigaar ki raftar se kheenchi jati hai, aur bigaar ke doran wire mein paida stresses mechanical testing machine mein lage munasib electronic device se lagatar nape jate hain. Force-elongation diagram ya stress-strain curve X-Y chart recorder par khud ban jata hai; ductile material ka aam stress-strain curve Fig. 5.5 mein hai.

blocks.alt: Stress aur strain ka graph. Origin se A tak seedhi lakeer (proportional limit, jahan Hooke ka qanoon chalta hai), B par mudti hai (elastic limit ya yield point), C tak charhti hai (ultimate tensile stress) aur D par girti hai (toot ka point). B tak ka hissa elastic aur baaqi plastic hai.
blocks.caption: Ductile maadde ka stress-strain curve (Figure 5.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Bigaar ke ibtidai marhale mein stress curve par nuqte A tak strain ke saath seedhi lakeer mein barhta hai, jo proportional limit (sigma_p) hai, yani woh sab se bara stress jo material stress aur strain ke darmiyan seedhi lakeer ki tanasubiyat khoye baghair sah sake. Hooke ka qanoon, jo kehta hai ke strain (bigaar) stress (force ya wazan) ke seedhe tanasub mein hai, hisse OA mein chalta hai. A se B tak stress aur strain tanasub mein nahi.

blocks.title: Elastic limit
blocks.text: Agar O aur B ke darmiyan kisi bhi nuqte par wazan hataya jaye to curve wapas usi raste par chalta hai aur material apni asal lambai par wapas aata hai; hisse OB mein material elastic kaha jata hai. Nuqta B yield point hai, aur B par stress ki qeemat elastic limit sigma_e hai.

Agar stress yield stress ya elastic limit se aage barhaya jaye to namoona mustaqil taur par badal jata hai aur stress hatane ke baad apni asal shakal ya paimaish dobara nahi pata. Is rawayye ko plasticity kehte hain; plasticity ka hissa curve ka B se C tak hissa hai. Nuqta C material ki ultimate tensile strength (UTS) sigma_u zahir karta hai, woh zyada se zyada stress jo material sah sakta hai, jise material ki nominal strength mana ja sakta hai. Nuqta C paar hone par material nuqte D par toot jata hai, jo fracture stress sigma_f ke mutabiq hai.

blocks.title: Ductile aur brittle madde
blocks.text: Woh madde jo tootne tak plastic bigaar sahte hain ductile madde hain, maslan seesa, copper aur wrought iron. Woh madde jo elastic limit tak pohnchte hi toot jayein brittle madde hain, maslan sheesha aur high-carbon steel; beryllium, bismuth aur chromium bhi brittle dhatein hain.

blocks.title: Example 5.1
blocks.text: 12 mm diameter ki steel wire lakri ke shahteer se bandhi aur tractor se kheenchi jati hai; shahteer aur tractor ke darmiyan wire ki lambai 11 m hai aur shahteer kheenchne ko 10 000 N force chahiye. Wire mein stress nikalein. Hal: tensile stress sigma = F/A = 10 000 N / (3.14 x (6 x 10^-3 m)^2) = 88.46 x 10^6 N m^-2 = 88.46 MPa.

blocks.caption: Stress-strain curve ke nuqte
rows: Hooke ka qanoon: strain stress ke tanasub mein; A = proportional limit sigma_p
elastic magar tanasub mein nahi; B = yield point, elastic limit sigma_e
plastic: mustaqil bigaar; C = ultimate tensile strength sigma_u

blocks.prompt: Stress-strain curve ka kaun sa hissa Hooke ke qanoon par chalta hai (MCQ 5.1)? Chhote bigaar ke liye stress/strain ki nisbat mustaqil hai; bohat bare bigaar par us ka kya hota hai (constructed response 5.1)?
blocks.explanation: Proportional-limit hissa OA. A ke baad curve murta hai, to nisbat mustaqil nahi rehti: A aur B ke darmiyan material elastic rehte hue bhi yeh ghatti hai, aur yield point B ke baad strain thore se izafi stress par barhta hai, to nisbat tootne tak tezi se girti hai.

items: Ductile material ka stress-strain curve: OA seedha (Hooke ka qanoon, proportional limit); OB elastic (B = yield point, elastic limit); BC plastic, C = ultimate tensile strength; D = fracture. Ductile: tootne se pehle plastic bigaar (seesa, copper, wrought iron); brittle: elastic limit ke zara baad toot (sheesha, high-carbon steel, Be, Bi, Cr). Example 5.1: 88.46 MPa.
